messages:
olivia: heads-up: PR #501 (guides/migration/stateful-sessions) failed docs CI. preview: https://staging-docs/redwood/pr/501 — linkcheck + vale + spellcheck
marc: paste the short CI errors?
olivia: 
```
Linkcheck: Broken external link -> https://thirdparty.example.com/session-persist (404)
vale: PROSE: 'guys' found in docs/guides/migration/stateful-sessions.md:17 -> avoid gendered language
spellcheck: 'redwood' lowercase found; project style requires 'Redwood'
```
yasmin: oof. the third-party link was in an example comment. we should either remove external link or replace with our hosted example showing session store config. i'll swap it to https://docs.redwood.ai/examples/session-store
marc: i'll take the vale and spellcheck fixes. changing 'guys' -> 'team' and 'redwood' -> 'Redwood' across the file. pushing tiny patch now
ci-bot: build started for PR #501 (docs-preview + linkcheck + vale + spellcheck)
docs-reviewer: FYI this touches the migration guide that goes out with next week's breaking changes. If it lands after the cut we'll need a backport to the stable branch. Tagging @eng-release for merge window guidance.
eng-release: noted. what's the impact? docs-only but relates to breaking change docs. If merged post-cut we'll create a patch release. Recommend fast-track before today's 18:00 UTC cut.
marc: pushed commit 1782604478 — replaced link with internal example, updated wording. local linters clean.
ci-bot: preview: linkcheck now flags redirect (302) for https://docs.redwood.ai/examples/session-store -> redirected to /examples/session-store/ - log: https://ci.example.com/builds/10188/log
yasmin: use canonical path with trailing slash: /examples/session-store/ — i'll push that tiny tweak
marc: pushed commit 1782604503 — canonicalized URL and fixed a typo in the example code comment
ci-bot: vale now passes, spellcheck passes, linkcheck passed. Requesting review.
docs-reviewer: reviewing now. small nit: sample config block indentation inconsistent, fixed inline in review. Approving for merge with fast-track tag.
eng-release: confirmed fast-track for docs-only. merging allowed before cut. Please add the backport checklist item so we can cut a patch if necessary.
olivia: thanks — will add checklist item and merge.
ci-bot: PR #501 merged by docs-bot at 1782604586
marc: opening follow-up issue #246 to scan for lowercase 'redwood' occurrences across site
yasmin: also adding a vale rule to ban 'guys' and a few other casual terms to reduce churn
docs-reviewer: great. closing this thread — thanks everyone :tada:
